svg.title: Same certificate, two signature algorithms
svg.desc: Drawn to scale. Ed25519: 246 bytes of structure, 32 of key, 64 of signature, 342 total. ML-DSA-44: 270 bytes of structure, 1312 of key, 2420 of signature, 4002 total.

text.tspan: the ASN.1 skeleton barely moves (246 to 270 bytes).
the cryptography is what grows: 96 bytes become 3732.
